objective: Split relationship extraction into raw vs derived facts. Land import resolution and call resolution. Make the 6 Phase-0 ground-truth tests pass.

in: Define RawImportFact and RawCallFact types to distinguish scanner observations from resolution results.
Update RelationshipExtractor to capture complete raw fact metadata (aliases, receiver text, scope path, etc.) for all supported languages.
Implement Import Resolver supporting relative paths, extensionless imports, index files, and package classification.
Implement scope-aware Call Resolver supporting local symbols, enclosing scopes, class members, and imported bindings.
Refactor PipelineOrchestrator to separate raw fact extraction from the resolution pass.
Update ExportedGraph schema to support resolutionStatus, evidence, and candidate IDs for ambiguous edges.
Make the 6 Phase-0 ground-truth tests pass: identity-anchored endpoints, explicit unresolved/ambiguous states, alias binding, and qualified context preservation.
out: Header parser (Phase 2.5) - no parsing of @imports or @exports in source comments.
Graph validation contract (Phase 6) - no runtime rejection of invalid artifacts (audit only).
RAG facets (Phase 7) - no indexing or search changes.

hard_constraints: Read-only role for prep agent - no source code edits, staging, or commits.
Must preserve receiver context in call facts (e.g., obj.save() must record 'obj' as receiver).
Must use canonical CodeRef IDs for all resolved endpoints in the graph.
No suggestions about HOW to implement; focus on WHAT changes and WHY.
